title: @move.to.series.dirs
description: Partition DICOM files into series directories by copying or moving them to new series directories.

action.description: Specify action to perform: copy or move. Default is copy.
action.title: Action

dprefix.description: Specify directory root for output series directories. Default is current directory.
dprefix.title: Directory Prefix

tag.description: Specify the DICOM tag to use for partitioning. Default is 0020,0011 (REL Series Number).
tag.title: DICOM Tag

test.description: Run in test mode, only show what would be done without actually moving any files.
test.title: Test Flag
